title: Razor Hill Barracks
wikitext:
[[image:Razor Hill Barracks.jpg|thumb|The Razor Hill Barracks]]
The '''Razor Hill Barracks''' features trainers for [[warrior]]s, [[priest]]s, [[shaman]]s and [[first aid]]. It also has a general goods vendor. Along with the [[zeppelin]] tower and [[Tiragarde Keep]], the barracks is one of the largest structures in [[Durotar]] (excluding [[Orgrimmar]]).
